author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
How many attempts will it take for Adam to successfully machine a custom end mill collet for his Pantograph machine? As Adam learns over the course of a month in this machining endeavor, way more than he could have guessed at the start!

Adam Savage's Pantograph Mill: https://youtu.be/pku2VRADLGk
Adam's Pantograph Mill spanner wrench build: https://youtu.be/PySdrA04M3o
The Joy of Machining a Solid Acrylic Tool Tray: https://youtu.be/E6dF9-iykVg
